name: Ground Sensor
description: The single source of ground contact: whether the character is standing on walkable ground, how long since it last was, and the normal of the surface under it. Every air-mobility component reads this rather than probing independently, because coyote time is defined as time-since-grounded and three separate probes would disagree about when that clock started. Ground steeper than maxWalkableAngle reports as airborne with isOnSteepSlope set, so a character slides off a cliff face instead of standing on it.

inputs.name: probeDistance
inputs.description: How far below the feet to sample, in the same units as movement.basic_walk walkSpeed. Too small and the sensor flickers on stairs; too large and the character appears grounded while falling.

inputs.name: maxWalkableAngle
inputs.description: Degrees from vertical. A surface steeper than this is not ground: isGrounded stays false and isOnSteepSlope goes true.

inputs.name: landingSpeedThreshold
inputs.description: Downward speed at or above which a landing counts as heavy. Carried on movement.grounded so landing effects can distinguish a step down from a fall.

outputs.name: timeSinceGrounded
outputs.description: Seconds since isGrounded was last true. Zero while grounded. This is the value coyote time is measured against.
